`list_canvases` can filter by folder, type, and depth, and horizontal `BarChart` labels size their SVG gutters automatically so long categories and values are not clipped.

- `list_canvases` accepts optional `folder`, `type` (`"canvas"` or `"folder"`), and `depth` (for example `1` for direct children).
- Horizontal `BarChart` expands its left and right SVG padding and `viewBox` width to fit category and value labels, and scales plot height when there are many categories.
